NJ|security_deposits|N.J.S.A. 46:8-26.note: The text says the law covers residential rentals, with one exception: owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings, which means no more than two rental units besides the owner's. It also says a tenant there can bring the law into effect 30 days after a written request to the landlord. This matches the rule in substance.
